title: Junior Research Associate – AI & Computer Science
description:
**Junior Research Associate – Computer Science Research Paper Writer**

**Company:** Softscholars Technologies  
**Location:** Gandhipuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** On-site (In-office only)  
**Open Positions:** 5

**Salary and Career Progression**

* **Initial Designation:** Junior Research Associate
* **Initial Salary:** ₹15,000 per month
* **Training and Evaluation Period:** 6 Months
* **After Successful Evaluation:** Promotion to Research Associate
* **Revised Salary:** Based on performance and technical capabilities.

Salary and employment terms will comply with applicable statutory requirements.

**About Softscholars Technologies**

Softscholars Technologies is a research-oriented organization working in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and emerging technology domains.

We support research and technical development activities involving research papers, scientific publications, technical documentation and innovative research projects.

We are looking for motivated and technically inclined engineering graduates to join our team as Junior Research Associates.

This is an opportunity for fresh graduates to develop a professional career in academic research, technical writing and AI/Computer Science research.

**About the Role**

Selected candidates will initially join as Junior Research Associates and undergo a structured six-month training and performance evaluation programme.

During this period, candidates will work alongside experienced researchers, participate in ongoing research projects and gradually develop the skills required to independently handle research assignments.

The role combines research analysis, technical documentation, scientific writing and exposure to practical Computer Science research activities.

**Research Domains**

Candidates will have opportunities to work in one or more of the following areas:

* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* Deep Learning and Data Science
* Computer Vision and Image Processing
* Cybersecurity and Network Security
* Internet of Things (IoT)
* Wireless and Computer Networks
* Signal and Image Processing
* Emerging Computer Science Technologies

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Search, read and analyze recent scientific research papers.
* Conduct literature reviews and identify research gaps.
* Prepare research comparison tables and technical summaries.
* Assist in developing research methodologies and technical documentation.
* Support the preparation of research papers and technical manuscripts.
* Organize references and citations using IEEE and other academic formats.
* Assist with Python/MATLAB-based research experiments, depending on project requirements.
* Support dataset analysis, model evaluation and result documentation.
* Prepare technical reports, research summaries and project documentation.
* Collaborate with senior researchers on ongoing research projects.
* Maintain accuracy, originality and quality in research documentation.

**Six-Month Training and Development Programme**

The initial six months will focus on developing practical research and technical skills.

**– Research Fundamentals**

* Understanding research papers and scientific publications.
* Literature searching and reference management.
* Academic document preparation.

**– Literature Review and Analysis**

* Research paper analysis.
* Literature review preparation.
* Research comparison tables and technical summaries.

**– Research Methodology**

* Understanding research problems and research gaps.
* Methodology documentation.
* Technical analysis and reporting.

**– Technical Research**

* Introduction to AI/ML research methodologies.
* Dataset analysis and experimentation support.
* Python/MATLAB-based research activities, depending on project requirements.

**– Research Paper Development**

* Technical manuscript preparation.
* Results and discussion documentation.
* Research publication workflows.

**– Independent Task Evaluation**

* Handling assigned research activities.
* Independent technical documentation.
* Quality and performance evaluation.

Upon successful completion of the programme, candidates will be promoted to Research Associate with revised responsibilities and salary.

**Career Progression**

Junior Research Associate

↓

Research Associate

↓

Senior Research Associate

↓

Technical Research Engineer

↓

Research Team Lead

Career progression and salary increments will depend on demonstrated skills, performance and organizational requirements.

**Educational Qualification**

**Only Engineering Graduates are eligible:** B.E. / B.Tech

* Computer Science Engineering
* Information Technology
* Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* Electronics and Communication Engineering
* Other relevant engineering disciplines

**Experience**

* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with up to one year of experience in technical writing, research assistance, programming or academic projects may also apply.

**Required Skills**

* Good English reading and writing skills.
* Basic understanding of Computer Science concepts.
* Analytical and logical thinking.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and document formatting.
* Interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and emerging technologies.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Willingness to learn new technical concepts.
* Ability to work collaboratively with a research team.

**Additional Advantage:**

* Basic programming knowledge in Python or MATLAB.
* Experience with academic projects or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with research papers and IEEE formatting.

**Why Join Softscholars Technologies?**

* Structured six-month professional development programme.
* Hands-on exposure to AI/ML and Computer Science research.
* Guidance and mentorship from experienced researchers.
* Opportunity to work on real-world research projects.
* Development of technical and scientific writing skills.
* Exposure to international journal and conference publication workflows.
* Defined career progression within the research team.
* Performance-based salary growth and professional development.

**Employment Terms**

* Full-time, in-office employment.
* Initial six-month training and performance evaluation period.
* Appointment letter and clearly defined employment terms.
* Confidentiality and intellectual property obligations applicable to company and client projects.
* Candidates should be genuinely interested in developing a career in research and technical development.
* Reasonable notice requirements will apply as specified in the employment agreement.

**Selection Process**

**Round 1 – Preliminary Screening**

Resume evaluation and a short telephone discussion.

**Round 2 – Technical and English Writing Assessment**

Evaluation of basic Computer Science knowledge, research understanding, analytical ability and written communication.

**Round 3 – Face-to-Face Interview**

Discussion of technical knowledge, career interests and suitability for the research role.

**Important Hiring Information**

* This is a full-time, in-office position at Gandhipuram, Coimbatore.
* Work-from-home or remote work options are not available.
* Candidates must be comfortable commuting or relocating before joining.
* We are looking for candidates who genuinely wish to develop a career in research rather than those seeking temporary employment for a few weeks.
* Candidates should be available to join on the mutually agreed date.
* Please apply only if you are comfortable with the salary, work location and employment terms.
* Interview attendance must be confirmed in advance.

AntSquad Branding Studio is a Coimbatore-based creative branding and design agency and part of HighThink Media Box Pvt. Ltd.

We help businesses build strong brand identities through brand strategy, creative design, digital marketing, website development, SEO and content creation.

Our team works with clients from different industries, creating meaningful brand experiences and digital solutions. At AntSquad, employees get opportunities to work on real client projects, explore creative ideas and develop their professional skills in a collaborative environment.

The ideal candidate must have strong expertise in pre-production, production and post-production, along with practical experience in directing shoots, coordinating production teams, working with ad directors and managing creative projects from concept to final delivery.

The candidate will be responsible for maintaining creative quality and delivering impactful visual content for multiple client brands.

* Develop creative concepts, stories and campaign ideas for different brands.
* Write engaging scripts for advertisements, promotional videos, brand films, reels and digital campaigns.
* Create storylines, storyboards, shot concepts and visual references.
* Develop compelling brand narratives and storytelling approaches.
* Review and refine scripts and creative content.

**2. Pre-Production Management**

* Handle the complete pre-production planning process for agency shoots.
* Develop concepts, scripts, storyboards and shot lists.
* Prepare production schedules, budgets and shooting plans.
* Coordinate location scouting, casting, talent selection and production requirements.

* Handle on-set challenges and ensure smooth production activities.
* Ensure shoots are completed within the planned schedule and budget.

**4. Post-Production Management**

* Supervise the complete post-production process from raw footage to final delivery.

* Review video edits, colour grading, animation, visual effects and sound design.
* Provide creative and technical feedback to improve final output.
* Ensure consistency in storytelling, visual quality and brand identity.
* Manage revisions, client feedback and final approvals.
* Ensure final videos meet quality standards and delivery deadlines.

**5. Advertising & Creative Direction**

* Develop creative concepts for advertisements and promotional campaigns.
* Collaborate with ad directors and production teams.
* Translate client requirements into effective advertising ideas.
* Oversee brand films, promotional videos and digital advertisements.
* Maintain creative quality and consistency across projects.

**6. Team Handling & Leadership**

* Lead and manage content writers, video editors, designers and production professionals.
* Assign responsibilities and monitor team deliverables.
* Guide team members in storytelling, scripting and creative execution.
* Review work and provide constructive creative feedback.
* Manage production teams and ensure timely project completion.

**7. Client & Project Coordination**

* Understand client briefs and business requirements.
* Present creative concepts, scripts and production ideas.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams throughout the production process.
* Manage multiple projects and production schedules.
* Handle client feedback and revisions while maintaining creative quality.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3–6 years of experience in content creation, film production, creative direction, advertising or media production.

* Thorough understanding of pre-production, production and post-production workflows.

* Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage production budgets, schedules and multiple projects.

**Who Should Apply?**

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Can independently develop stories, concepts and scripts for advertisements and brand films.
* Has practical experience managing all three stages of video production.
* Can plan and direct agency shoots and coordinate with ad directors and production crews.

**Department:** Factory Operations

**Location:** Homworks Plant – Sulur, Coimbatore

**Role Type:** Full-Time | On-Site (Shop-Floor Support)

**BE PART OF SOMETHING BIG.**

Join **Homworks** at Sulur, Coimbatore, as we build and scale a landmark **35-acre manufacturing facility** powered by state-of-the-art, fully automated German machinery lines.

We are looking for a detailed-oriented **Technical Writer** to work directly alongside our **Factory Head** and operational teams. In this role, you will get firsthand exposure to industrial operations, working close to the shop floor to translate complex manufacturing processes into clear, accurate, and structured documentation.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Shop-Floor Observation & Process Capture:** Observe manufacturing activities, machine workflows, operational discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives directly on the shop floor.
* **Documentation & Standard Operating Procedures:** Draft, format, and maintain clear English SOPs, process flow notes, work instructions, quality checklists, technical reports, and operating manuals.
* **Active Learning & Synthesis:** Engage with engineers and technicians, ask probing questions, and convert complex technical jargon or machinery processes into simple, easy-to-understand documents.
* **Action & Information Tracking:** Track key decisions, observations, and action points from operational meetings; keep all documents meticulously organized, updated, and accessible.
* **Factory Head Coordination:** Provide direct administrative, documentation, and coordination support to the Factory Head to support smooth daily operations and execution.

**WHO SHOULD APPLY (QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS)**

* **Strong English Communication:** Flawless written English, excellent grammar, and the ability to explain complex technical concepts in a logical, concise manner.
* **Sharp Analytical & Listening Skills:** Strong observational capabilities, active listening skills, high attention to detail, and a genuine curiosity about industrial machinery and manufacturing operations.
* **Shop-Floor Mindset:** Willingness to spend time on the active production floor, collaborate directly with factory operators, and grow alongside the facility.
* **Experience Level:** Candidates with prior manufacturing/industrial exposure are preferred; ambitious freshers with exceptional technical writing ability and a passion for plant operations are welcome to apply.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title: Project Co-Ordinator**  
**Company : Antsquad Branding Studio**  
**Job Location: Anna Silai, Coimbatore**

**About the Role** HighThink Media Box is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and ownership-driven Project Coordinator to lead and manage branding and creative projects from initiation to final delivery. This role is critical to our agency’s success, acting as the central bridge between clients, creative teams, and leadership. The Project Coordinator will ensure that every project is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with brand strategy and quality standards.

This is a high-responsibility role and a key pillar in scaling HighThink Media Box operations. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced creative environment, understands branding workflows, and can manage multiple projects while maintaining clarity, structure, and accountability across teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

* Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of branding and creative projects.
* Define project scope, timelines, deliverables, and milestones.
* Break down projects into actionable tasks and assign them to relevant teams.
* Ensure all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

**Client Coordination & Communication**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution.
* Understand client requirements, objectives, and brand expectations clearly.
* Provide regular updates, progress reports, and status communication.
* Handle client feedback professionally and translate it into actionable tasks.
* Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear communication and reliability.

**Team Collaboration & Workflow Management**

* Coordinate with Brand Designers, Video Editors, Content Writers, and Digital Marketers.
* Ensure smooth communication between internal teams and avoid bottlenecks.
* Conduct daily/weekly follow-ups to track progress and maintain accountability.
* Ensure all team members are aligned with project goals and deadlines.

**Timeline & Delivery Management**

* Create and maintain project timelines, trackers, and dashboards.
* Monitor progress and proactively address delays or risks.
* Ensure timely delivery without compromising quality.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously with structured prioritization.

**Quality Control & Brand Alignment**

* Ensure all deliverables meet agency quality standards and brand guidelines.
* Review outputs before client submission to maintain consistency and excellence.
* Work closely with creative teams to ensure brand strategy is reflected in execution.

**Meeting & Documentation**

* Schedule and lead internal and client meetings.
* Document meeting notes, action items, and responsibilities.
* Ensure follow-ups are completed within deadlines.
* Maintain structured project documentation, reports, and archives.

**Risk Management & Problem Solving**

* Identify potential risks, delays, or resource gaps early.
* Take proactive steps to resolve issues and keep projects on track.
* Handle unexpected challenges calmly and provide solutions quickly.

**Process Improvement & Productivity**

* Identify gaps in workflows and suggest improvements.
* Implement tools and systems to improve team efficiency and project tracking.
* Contribute to building standard operating procedures (SOPs) for project management.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–4 years of experience in Project Management, Client Servicing, or Operations/Coordination roles.
* Experience in a branding, advertising, digital marketing, or creative agency is highly preferred.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making mindset.
* High level of ownership and accountability.

**Technical & Tool Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Basic understanding of branding processes, creative workflows, and digital marketing deliverables.

**Preferred Traits**

* Understands branding, creativity, and client expectations.
* Can bring structure to a fast-moving creative environment.
* Is highly proactive and solution-oriented.
* Takes complete ownership of projects from start to finish.
* Has strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Can confidently interact with both clients and internal teams.
* Is adaptable and thrives under pressure.
* Focuses on driving execution leadership that directly impacts client satisfaction, delivery timelines, team productivity, and agency growth.

**Work Location:** In person

**How to Apply**

Send your resume to: **hr@highthink.in**  
Or contact HR Manager at: **90922 50922**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
